correctness.rationale: For real n>=2 and G_n(x)=sum_{i<j}|x_i-x_j|, coarea/layer-cake reduces the norm of D_n=I-C_n to nontrivial binary cuts, since D_n 1=0 and the complete-pair Gini total variation admits exact cut decomposition. Exact rational exhaustive evaluation of all 2^n-2 cuts at n=2,3,4 yields 1/2,5/6,11/12. For n>=5 the signed third-coordinate witness has pairwise formula G_n(D e3)=2(n-1)/3+(n+7)(H_n-H3)-2(n-3); its excess F_n has F5=1/15 and all subsequent first differences positive by a nonnegative second difference (n-5)/[(n+1)(n+2)]. The upper bound follows from a directly proved row-stochastic column-mass inequality G(Px)<=M G(x), max column sum H_n for Cesaro, hence Λ_n<=1+H_n. Witness grows log n+O(1) and upper bound also log n+O(1), establishing the exact leading coefficient one. Independently recomputed finite small-cut maxima with fractions; no extrapolation of numerical checks is used.

value.rationale: The natural residual of prefix averaging is a high-pass filter whose stability in complete-pair Gini variation matters for dispersion measurements. The sharp first amplifying dimension five differs from six for the averaging map itself, and a global all-n proof establishes a logarithmic instability coefficient one.
